source_conflicts.resolution: Source table does not allocate a dose. Specialist review unless an existing hold still requires recovery to 100.
NCCP ANC >=1 differs from common SmPC WBC >=4. These measures are not interchangeable; reconcile the product and clinical context before restart.
Current common SmPC 70% row includes platelets 24,000-74,999 but 50% row includes <25,000. No automated dose from that overlapping source table.
NCCP 6 months after treatment differs from current common SmPC 7 months for women/4 months for men. Confirm the actual products and combined regimen with pharmacy.
NCCP PFTs are conditional; current common SmPC recommends baseline and ongoing tests. Source-specific planning must remain explicit.
75% of original lomustine dose requires the actual original capped dose and prior reduction history. No automatic multiplication of a nominal 90 mg/m 2 reference.

findings.finding: Grade 3 hypertension previously triggered discontinuation without establishing persistence.
findings.resolution: Separate grade 2/3 review from persisting grade 3 or grade 4 discontinuation; preserve uncontrolled/symptomatic treatment-day hold and product-specific permanent-stop pathways.
findings.source: NCCP p4 Table4; EMA SmPC4.4 pp6-7

findings.finding: Platelet range 80-99 omitted fractional values above 99; prior hold recovery was not independently represented.
findings.resolution: Use >=80 and <100 for the unallocated source band; existing count-related holds require both ANC>=1 and platelets>=100. No unsupported reduction percentage.

findings.finding: DLCO<60 was used as an automatic stopping threshold unsupported by these documents.
findings.resolution: Replace with source-qualified FVC or DLCO<70% pulmonary-risk review. New symptoms still prompt assessment.

findings.finding: Severe hepatic impairment, repeat interval, cumulative exposure and restart context were absent.
findings.resolution: Add severe-hepatic not-recommended hold/review, minimum 42-day repeat interval, cumulative product limit 1000 mg/m2, and prior dose/nadir/count review.
findings.source: NCCP p3 Table2; lomustine SmPC4.2 pp1-2

findings.finding: Intracranial haemorrhage, recent stroke/MI and minimal-enhancement/gliomatosis exclusions were absent.
findings.resolution: Add explicit regimen exclusions, retain individual relevance and distinguish baseline indication/eligibility review from clearance.

findings.finding: Nephrotic syndrome and tracheoesophageal fistula were not independent stop pathways.
findings.resolution: Separate nephrotic syndrome from dipstick4+ and quantified protein; any TE fistula stops even below grade4. Add other internal-fistula review.
findings.source: NCCP p4 Tables3-4; EMA SmPC4.4 pp5-7

findings.finding: Separate lomustine Day1 and bevacizumab-only administrations lacked executable context.
findings.resolution: Guard lomustine administration rules on bevacizumab-only visits; delayed toxicity still requires consultant assessment. Preserve 5mg/kg Days1/15/29 versus 7.5mg/kg Days1/22 within 42-day cycles, up to6 cycles.

findings.finding: Lomustine renal reduction could produce false precision from a nominal schedule without knowing the original capped dose.
findings.resolution: Show NCCP 75% of ORIGINAL dose at CrCl30-50 inclusive as consultant review, block automatic numeric multiplication and reconcile previous actual dose, cap and reductions. Below30 or haemodialysis is not recommended.

findings.finding: Surgery timing did not independently establish wound healing.
findings.resolution: At least28 days after major surgery AND complete healing are required; missing healing remains unassessed. Preserve 00742-specific preoperative guidance; do not transplant it into00804.

findings.finding: Monitoring, drug interactions, support readiness and product-supply safety needed explicit review.
findings.resolution: Add review flags and handoff for weekly CBC for at least6 weeks after lomustine, PFT planning, warfarin INR, BP/protein, single-course capsule supply, and separate antiemetic plans for oral lomustine versus bevacizumab-only visits.

findings.finding: Current common lomustine SmPC conflicts or ambiguities cannot be resolved by copying a dose table.
findings.resolution: Preserve NCCP ANC versus product WBC recovery difference, overlapping nadir platelet rows, PFT scheduling difference, and contraception6months versus women7/men4months. Require product-specific clinical/pharmacy reconciliation.
findings.source: NCCP p3 Table1/p5; lomustine common SmPC revision2026-01-16 sections4.2/4.4/4.6

findings.finding: Consent could conflate treatment licensing and infusion method.
findings.resolution: Document glioblastoma outside current EMA Avastin indications, NCCP unlicensed lomustine supply, and separate off-label rapid-infusion method.

integration_handoff.schedule: 00742: bevacizumab5mg/kg D1/15/29;00804:7.5mg/kg D1/22. Both lomustine90mg/m2 max160mg D1 only, q42days up to6cycles. No daily lomustine. No RT schedule inferred.
integration_handoff.support_script_required: nccp-lomustine-bev-v08439: oral moderate-high lomustine Day1, minimal bevacizumab-only days; verify local medicines and pharmacy mapping.
integration_handoff.monitoring: Show baseline and ongoing bloods, BP and urine protein; product weekly CBC for at least6weeks after lomustine; delayed marrow nadir commonly4-6weeks; conditional renal/liver/PFT/echo/INR plans; no fabricated mandatory MRI frequency.
integration_handoff.toxicity_anatomy: Preserve full approved detailed anatomy. Anchor marrow/infection/bleeding, lungs/delayed fibrosis, brain/headache/seizure/PRES, blood vessels/BP/clots/bleeding, kidneys/proteinuria, gut/perforation/fistula, wound healing, nausea and fertility. Do not replace with simplified body diagram.
integration_handoff.three_page_pack: Page1 schedule, phases and tests; page2 complete regimen-specific anatomical toxicity; page3 front/back wallet, six-cycle tracker, cutting/print instructions, automatic regimen QR, labelled placeholder contacts and webapp steps. Complete printable handbook must retain all content offline.
integration_handoff.consent: Discuss treatment intent, evidence limitations and EMA off-label glioblastoma context; lomustine unlicensed supply; rapid bevacizumab infusion is a separate governance issue.
integration_handoff.contraception: Do not use generic six-month wording for everyone without reconciliation: NCCP six months versus current lomustine common product women seven months/men four months; bevacizumab component/actual product must also be checked.
integration_handoff.clv_reference_boundary: The supplied glioma patient reference does not establish medulloblastoma/PNET disease education for00806 CLV. That third protocol needs separate disease-appropriate patient evidence.
integration_handoff.research_handoff: All five current NCCP PDFs, texts, hashes and detailed requirements are retained under neuro-v39-research/source-requirements.json.00805/00813/00806 remain implementation tasks for other owners.
